The LAP Chaac tilt fire rated LED downlight is a versatile lighting solution for various indoor applications. This 5.5W integrated LED downlight offers 600 lumens and features a stylish brushed nickel bezel. It is fire rated for 30, 60, and 90 minutes, providing enhanced safety for installations in new builds and renovations. With an IP65 rating, it is suitable for bathroom zone 2, as well as kitchens and other damp areas. The colour temperature is adjustable between 2700K warm white, 4000K cool white, and 6000K daylight, allowing customisation for different moods and tasks. It is also dimmable and has a tilt function for directional lighting.
